request.style: English, soul, warm female solo voice with gospel choir backing, upright bass, soft piano, gentle drums, cello, hopeful and intimate mood, 78 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The Lord is my light and my salvation
I have no reason to fear
He is the stronghold of my life
My heart will not be afraid

[Verse]
Evildoers close in to devour me
But they will stumble and fall
Though an army camps against me
My confidence stands tall

[Chorus]
One thing I ask of the Lord
This is the only thing I seek
To dwell in the house of the Lord
For all the days that I have

[Verse]
I want to gaze on his beauty
And seek him in his temple
In the day of trouble he keeps me
Safe in his shelter

[Chorus]
One thing I ask of the Lord
This is the only thing I seek
To dwell in the house of the Lord
For all the days that I have

[Bridge]
He hides me under the cover
Of his tent upon a rock
My head is lifted high above
The enemies who surround me

[Outro]
I will sing and make music
To the Lord in his tent
Hear my voice when I call
Be gracious and answer me

[Chorus]
One thing I ask of the Lord
This is the only thing I seek
To dwell in the house of the Lord
For all the days that I have
